items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 Facing Headwinds

items.title: Does Chipotle (CMG) Balancing Food Safety Lawsuits With Global Expansion Reshape Its Risk‑Reward Profile?
items.summary: Earlier this month, Chipotle Mexican Grill faced a Minnesota federal lawsuit tied to a multistate Salmonella outbreak affecting over 200 reported customers, even as it continued rolling out promotions like Chipotle IQ and prepared to open its first restaurant in Saudi Arabia with franchise partner Alshaya Group.
